title: P&L by calendar month with expenses typed in
persona: Skincare founder who does the books monthly and types expenses in herself. From a real conversation (28 Sept).
opening: I need a P&L by calendar month: sales minus my expenses. I'll enter expenses like ads, salaries and packaging.

facts.months: Calendar months, January, February, not the last 30 days
facts.expenses: I type each expense with its month, amount and category
facts.sales: From the store's orders, after cancellations

success: the figures are by calendar month
expenses are entered in the app with an amount, a category and a month or date
each month shows sales, expenses and what is left
the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types
ends by asking whether to build
must_not: months shown as rolling 30-day windows instead of calendar months
jargon such as "boolean" or "set_fields" in what the owner reads
